headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Chris Jericho vs. Tomohiro Ishii went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.03. It marked Chris Jericho's 10th match with the title on the line. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

That Wednesday in 2019, the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Chris Jericho vs. Scorpio Sky went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.62. It was the first title opportunity of Scorpio Sky's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

Looking back to 2025, when Konosuke Takeshita vs. Roderick Strong met in a Continental Classic League Match, headlining the show on Collision, rated 7.12 ? a good, competitive contest ? part of that year's Thanksgiving.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2024, when Brody King vs. Darby Allin met in a Continental Classic League Match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 7.38 ? a well-worked match ? part of that year's Thanksgiving Eve '24.
